description: One AFK Orphan Story goes from state:ready through implementation, an approving model review and completion to Passing.

issues.title: Add the greeting
issues.body:
## What to build
A greeting.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] the greeting exists

Parent: None
Depends on: None

literal-noop.why: An implementation that changes nothing and claims nothing must be bounded, then blocked.

empty-usage.why: An implementation that exits cleanly with no output and zero tokens must be bounded, then blocked.

invalid-output.why: An iteration that signals done without doing the work must end blocked, not loop.

session-limit.why: A provider out of session budget makes no progress; the Tick hands off cleanly and the Story waits.

commit-no-push.why: Promotion pushes the Story's own branch, so an agent that only commits still completes.

amend-history.why: A rewrite inside one unreviewed iteration strands nothing; the Story completes.

literal-noop.why: A comment verdict with no findings blocks nothing, so the Story completes.

empty-usage.why: A reviewer that returns nothing must not be relaunched until the window closes.

invalid-output.why: A reviewer whose output never validates must not be relaunched until the window closes.

session-limit.why: A reviewer out of session budget spends no round; the Story waits In Review.

commit-no-push.why: A git misbehaviour profile; a reviewer cannot commit, so it reviews cooperatively.

amend-history.why: A git misbehaviour profile; a reviewer cannot commit, so it reviews cooperatively.
